lastCompletedStory.title: Add comment emission to stringifyToml (parser stays comment-tolerant)

nextStoryContext: stringifyToml(config, comments?) now accepts an optional TomlComments = Record<string, string[]> mapping section name -> array of comment-line strings (no '#' prefix, added automatically). Comments only render under sections that already exist in `config` as an object value (including an empty section `{}` for a comment-only block with zero active keys) -- a comments entry for a section name absent from `config` is silently ignored (no phantom section header is emitted). This keeps every round-trip parseToml(stringifyToml(config, comments)) deep-equal to `config`, since TOML comments are stripped by the parser and an empty `{}` section round-trips to `{}`. saveConfig/mergeIntoConfig were NOT touched (out of scope for US-001) -- a future story wiring `cam init` to emit commented example sections will need to thread a TomlComments argument through saveConfig too if it wants to persist comments to disk. Extracted a renderSectionLines helper out of stringifyToml to stay under Biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling (16->15) after adding the comments param.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Signature parse(input: string): object confirmed unchanged. Docs don't explicitly state comment-stripping behavior, but TOML v1.0.0 spec mandates it and this story's new test (parser ignores '#' lines) passes empirically against the real Bun.TOML.parse, so the code's comment-tolerance claim is verified by test, not just docs.
